patch.value: Explain rejected telemetry source-context overrides without leaking raw values

GitHub source https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1253. GitHub reports that unrecognized PM_TELEMETRY_SOURCE_CONTEXT values silently fall back to inferred automation and contaminate attribution. Existing accepted contexts and hard opt-outs must remain stable; rejected values may contain private data and must not be copied verbatim into events.

Accepted absent and rejected overrides have distinct tested behavior; rejection produces a bounded diagnostic naming accepted values; emitted attribution exposes rejection through a fixed marker without raw custom values; hard opt-outs still suppress all capture.
Explain rejected telemetry source-context overrides without leaking raw values
Lower agent recovery cost and preserve safe customizable SDK composition
